title: kbmon's sessions panel says what each Claude Code session is doing
goal: the sessions panel's data holds a sessions list, one entry per live Claude Code session in a checkout of the clone, with label (the s- label of the coord panel's rule), role (worker, sprint runner, planner, reviewer, interactive, benchmark agent, bare twin, observer or unknown, from a fixed rule table), item and item_title, sprint and sprint_title, step (claim, work, the landing's step, review or waiting), started, last_activity and spend_usd (null when no usage row names the session), read from the coord leases and intents, the claims ledgers' dispatch records, the ops rows, the item files, the query log's spool and the session's checkout and branch, with no model call and no command line read

run:
import json,os,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,uuid
T=os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp());g=lambda *a:s.run(['git','-C',T,*a],check=True,capture_output=True)
g('init','-q');g('-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@example.com','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','i')
W=os.path.join(T,'.claude','worktrees','agent-ST-aaaaaaaa');g('worktree','add','-q','-b','work/ST-aaaaaaaa',W)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T,'kb','_self','backlog'))
json.dump({'item_dir':'kb/_self/backlog'},open(os.path.join(T,'backlog.json'),'w'))
json.dump({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','kind':'story','title':'Plant a worker item','status':'doing','sprint':'SP-bbbbbbbb','priority':'P2','goal':'g'},open(os.path.join(T,'kb','_self','backlog','ST-aaaaaaaa.json'),'w'))
json.dump({'id':'SP-bbbbbbbb','kind':'sprint','title':'Plant sprint','status':'active','goal':'g'},open(os.path.join(T,'kb','_self','backlog','SP-bbbbbbbb.json'),'w'))
B=os.path.join(T,'bin');os.makedirs(B);shutil.copy('/bin/sleep',os.path.join(B,'claude'))
p=s.Popen([os.path.join(B,'claude'),'90'],cwd=W)
ws=str(uuid.uuid4())
json.dump({'ST-aaaaaaaa':{'by':'orch','session':'by:orch','worker_pid':p.pid,'worker_session':ws}},open(os.path.join(T,'.git','kb-backlog-claims.json'),'w'))
st=os.path.join(T,'c.sqlite');ok=False
s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','--store',st,'post','--kind','intent','--field','session='+ws,'--field','item=ST-aaaaaaaa'],check=True,capture_output=True)
try:
    time.sleep(1)
    o=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','sessions','--root',T,'--store',st],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120).stdout
    d=json.loads(o)['panels']['sessions'];ss=[x for x in (d.get('data') or {}).get('sessions') or [] if x.get('item')=='ST-aaaaaaaa']
    print(d.get('state'),ss)
    need={'label','role','item','item_title','sprint','sprint_title','step','started','last_activity','spend_usd'}
    ok=(len(ss)==1 and need<=set(ss[0]) and ss[0]['role']=='worker' and ss[0]['sprint']=='SP-bbbbbbbb'
        and ss[0]['item_title']=='Plant a worker item' and str(ss[0]['label']).startswith('s-') and ws not in o)
finally:
    p.kill();shutil.rmtree(T,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
